        if dy != 0:

        if abs(dx) > abs(dy):
            move_scores['right' if dx > 0 else 'left'] += 1
        elif abs(dy) > 0:
            move_scores['down' if dy > 0 else 'up'] += 1
        # If close, may consider staying

        elif abs(dy) > 0:
            move_scores['down' if dy > 0 else 'up'] += 1
    else:
        # No information, stay put
        move_scores['stay'] += 1

    # Select the move with the highest score

    dx, dy = moves[best_move]
